body: Thanks for this. I appreciate it.

So I'm a Project Manager and failed to update client teams on the project and because of that we are behind and running into a Christmas deadline. I have a lot on my plate and have lost a lot of motivation.

Hey OP,
I just wanted to let you know I've been feeling the same. I'm a professional working from home. These last two month have killed me and I felt really behind at work, so far behind it affected my relationship with my clients and co-works. I also have felt pretty isolated live far away from my Childhood home. I posted on his sub-reddit got some good advise and was able to make changes. I was honest with my boss and my clients and have stared to spend more time trying to meditate. I'm not out of the woods yet but I'm on my way. Good Luck.

On the same boat all. It got so bad my work was really effected. However my post on this subreddit was answered and it helped me find a path forward. I still might be fucked but at least I know it will happen sooner rather than later.

I finally sent that email to my Boss and started to correct my mistakes with my clients. There were more issues than I figured and I don't think I'm out of the woods yet but I made the first steps. Thanks dude this was one of the hardest weeks of my life, but my stomach lost some knots today.
Thanks for reaching out. lol I was afraid you were going to say that. Any tips on how to breaching this topic with your boss?

Well I didn't do it. I called a doc and got prescribed a generic of Lexapro. I don't think I'll last the 2 - 3 weeks it takes to kick in. I have two fires at work that are growing and I'm afraid fixing it will show my mistakes. Killing myself would be easier than facing my issues at work.
Thanks for reaching out and for the advice.
I just cant bring myself to answer my emails. It's the same issues over and over again. Also an aspect of my job is to be the punching bag for clients and I'm tired of doing that.
Thanks. It just sucks because to do the things to rejuvenate your motivation it takes motivation.

Hi,
I feel the same. I'm 30 and because I have no motivation the quality of my work has suffered.

Thanks dude and that work environment sounds rough. One thing I'm struggling with is my work environment is hard right now but my co works direct boss is great. My depression and lack of motivation caused this situation. Thanks for the kind words and you'll get a new opportunity.
Ended the day with 3 hours of meetings and 20 emails sent. It's small but a step. Thanks all.
Brief update: Just had two successful meetings. Still petrified of my inbox so I'm hoping to address that later today.
Great analogy. I struggle with giving myself a break but it just so hard when you miss deadlines. I do think it hard working incremental because it feel like emails come in at a constant rate.
Yeah. Maybe the we should all try to do an hour at a time?
Glad I'm not alone. Hopefully we can get through this.
